question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average total holding value, average holding return and average holding gain (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value), and average dividends of investors.
sql_query:
WITH hold AS (SELECT o.investor_id, SUM(o.current_value) h_val, AVG(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.returns_pct END) h_ret, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.current_value - o.cost END) h_gain, SUM(o.dividends) h_div FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o GROUP BY o.investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_val),2) AS avg_holding_value,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_ret),2) AS avg_holding_return,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_gain),2) AS avg_holding_gain,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_div),2) AS avg_dividends,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Among investors with every component recorded, list the top 10 ranked by a composite score defined as net cash flow plus total sector investment (all components in INR); break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
       ROUND(cf.c_net + al.a_inv,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(cf.c_net,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(al.a_inv,2) AS sector_investment
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL

Over investors that have all 3 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1, and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 al.a_inv AS sector_investment,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(sector_investment) mn_1, MAX(sector_investment) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (sector_investment-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0))/3.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.sector_investment,2) AS sector_investment,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift
FROM per, b

question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow, total rebalance amount, total scenario allocation shift (sum of new minus current allocation %) and risk score. Over investors that have all 4 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1, and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 rb.r_amt AS rebalance_amount,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 h.risk_score AS risk_score
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND rb.r_amt IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL AND h.risk_score IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(rebalance_amount) mn_1, MAX(rebalance_amount) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2, MIN(risk_score) mn_3, MAX(risk_score) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (rebalance_amount-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (risk_score-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.rebalance_amount,2) AS rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift,
       ROUND(per.risk_score,2) AS risk_score
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
